description: This file configures ESLint for a Next.js project, utilizing the @eslint/eslintrc package and the FlatCompat utility to extend predefined configurations such as 'next/core-web-vitals' and 'next/typescript'.

methods.name: __filename
methods.description: Contains the current filename path, obtained via fileURLToPath.

methods.name: __dirname
methods.description: Contains the directory name of the current module, derived from __filename.

methods.name: compat
methods.description: An instance of FlatCompat used to extend ESLint configurations.

methods.name: eslintConfig
methods.description: The ESLint configuration array, extending Next.js recommended configs.
